hotel_name: The St. Regis Costa Mujeres Resort, Cancun

skipped.reason: no Condé Nast Traveler hotel page found for this name

claims.text: The resort is a beachfront resort in Costa Mujeres, about 30 minutes north of Cancun Airport.

findings.quote: Just 30 minutes north of Cancun Airport, our Costa Mujeres beachfront resort captures the spirit of Quintana Roo

claims.text: Every room and suite has a private terrace, with views of sunrise over the sea and sunset behind the mangroves of Isla Blanca.

findings.quote: Within 163 beautifully appointed rooms and suites, each with private terraces, guests witness the sun rise over the sea and set behind the mangroves of Isla Blanca.

claims.text: Suites feature astrological motifs brought to life through light and custom fixtures.

findings.quote: In our suites, astrological motifs come to life through a delicate play of light and custom fixtures.

claims.text: Rooms have marble bathrooms with soaking tubs.

findings.quote: Marble bathrooms with soaking tubs.

claims.text: The resort has five restaurants: Costa Coral, Fish Market, Palmare Grill, The St. Regis Bar and Olivia.

findings.quote: Costa CoralFish MarketPalmare Grill The St. Regis BarOlivia
5 Restaurants

claims.text: Costa Coral serves Mexican cuisine rooted in the biodiversity of the milpa and is open for breakfast and dinner.

findings.quote:
Rooted in Mexico's rich culinary legacy and the biodiversity of the milpa, we elevate luxury dining in Cancun.

Open for breakfast and dinner
Mexican at Costa Coral

claims.text: Fish Market is a seafood restaurant with a raw bar, ceviches and shared rice dishes.

findings.quote: From the precision of our raw bar to signature ceviches and shared rice compositions, our seafood restaurant in Costa Mujeres honors the integrity of local produce.

claims.text: Palmare Grill is an oceanfront restaurant serving artisanal breads, sun-seared meats and coastal dishes made for sharing.

findings.quote: our oceanfront restaurant in Costa Mujeres serves artisanal breads, sun-seared meats, and coastal favorites crafted with local ingredients and designed for effortless sharing

claims.text: Olivia is a specialty coffee spot showcasing Mexican coffees with an artisanal bakery selection.

findings.quote: An elevated specialty coffee hub, where each cup becomes a refined daily ritual showcasing premium Mexican coffees, artisanal brewing techniques, complemented by an artisanal bakery selection

claims.text: St. Regis Butler service is available in all accommodations.

findings.quote: Available in all accommodations.

claims.text: The St. Regis Family Traditions program runs at the resort's Explorer's Club.

findings.quote: The Family Traditions signature St. Regis program offers travelers of all ages the opportunity to explore the destination and celebrate the art of play at our Explorer's Club.

claims.text: Guests can explore nearby reefs by boat.

findings.quote: invite you to explore nearby reefs by boat

claims.text: The resort was designed by the firm Sordo Madaleno and reimagines Mayan legends in stone, wood and metal.

findings.quote: Designed by award-winning firm Sordo Madaleno, the resort reimagines Mayan legends in stone, wood, and metal

claims.text: Some suites have private pools overlooking the Mesoamerican Barrier Reef and the mangrove reserve near Isla Blanca.

findings.quote: Experience total privacy in suites with private pools overlooking the Mesoamerican Barrier Reef and the sprawling mangrove reserve near Isla Blanca.

claims.text: Each evening butlers open bottles of Champagne with sabers to mark the transition from day to night.

findings.quote: Join our Butlers in celebrating the transition from day to night, where bottles of Champagne are opened with regal sabers

claims.text: The spa offers ancestral Mayan treatments and rituals inspired by the sea and the legacy of El Meco.

findings.quote: invites guests to to discover ancestral Mayan treatments and rituals inspired by the sea and and the legacy of El Meco

claims.text: The St. Regis Bar sits next to the Agave Library, a communal immersive bar.

findings.quote: A surrealist liquid landscape where heritage mixology meets daring infusions, adjacent to the Agave Library, a communal immersive bar.

claims.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service; Cancun International Airport is about 26.9 km away.

findings.quote: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.
CUN is located approximately 26.9 KM from the hotel.

claims.text: Breakfast is served at Costa Coral for a fee.

findings.quote: Yes, breakfast is available onsite at Costa Coral for a fee.
